propositions: The codebase uses two distinct headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) to describe one concept, creating inconsistency where criteria under SC are not counted by _count_ac_items, cannot carry the [operator-attested] tag, and are not individually checkable
Detectors, reviewers, and verifiers pool both headings and apply a single bar; no criterion implements a different evaluation path for SC versus AC, making the dual vocabulary vestigial

Collapsing Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria across detector regexes, routing indices, author guides, generated docs, eval specs, and 106 store tickets will unify the vocabulary and tighten the gates

Three live files legitimately retain SC-related strings (plan_review_T2.md for trial metrics, plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md for dod_uncertifiable wording) and must be explicitly excluded from the collapse
Migration is blocked until ADR 0053 grandfathering lands (external ticket 1f32), making the vocabulary rename affordable by preserving existing attestations
